ode1d.authority: Thornton & Marion, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems, Ch. 2–3（一维牛顿定律）
ode1d.assumptions: 一维、常质量、集总力；线性阻力或常力；非多体/柔性体；参数超范围时不保证工程精度

ode2d.authority: Taylor, Classical Mechanics, Ch. 2（平面牛顿定律）
ode2d.assumptions: 平面、常质量、集总；忽略三维耦合与柔性；非 CAD 运动学

circular.authority: Goldstein, Classical Mechanics, Ch. 3（有心势/开普勒问题的教科书形式）
circular.assumptions: 点质量、平方反比或匀速圆周示意；非 N 体星历、非摄动工业轨道确定

particles.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 2（点电荷场的教科书极限）
particles.assumptions: 点粒子、库仑/洛伦兹示意；无自能重整、非粒子输运求解器

nbody.authority: Murray & Dermott, Solar System Dynamics, Ch. 2（少体引力）
nbody.assumptions: 少体、牛顿引力、软化防奇点；非精密星历

euler.assumptions: 刚体姿态示意；万向节锁与顺序须按文献，非飞控解算

buoyancy.authority: Kundu, Fluid Mechanics, Ch. 1（阿基米德浮力）
buoyancy.assumptions: 静流体、完全浸没或简单吃水；非 CFD 自由液面

flow.authority: White, Fluid Mechanics（连续性与伯努利的教科书适用条件）
flow.assumptions: 不可压、定常、沿流线的原理图；非 CFD/管网水力计算软件

wave1d.authority: Kinsler, Fundamentals of Acoustics, Ch. 1；或 Pain, The Physics of Vibrations and Waves（一维波动方程）
wave1d.assumptions: 一维、常波速、有限差分；边界按模型声明；非三维全波仿真

doppler.authority: Halliday, Resnick, Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, 声波多普勒章节
doppler.assumptions: 匀速源/观察者、远小于光速；非宽带信号处理

interference.authority: Hecht, Optics, 双缝/双源干涉章节
interference.assumptions: 标量波、相干点源示意；非矢量衍射工业设计

field2d.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 2–3（静场）
field2d.assumptions: 二维静场或势的示意网格；非有限元电磁求解器

piston.authority: Çengel & Boles, Thermodynamics, 闭口系统活塞过程
piston.assumptions: 准静态、理想气体或给定过程指数；非 CFD 缸内过程

cycle.authority: Çengel & Boles, Thermodynamics, 动力/制冷循环章节
cycle.assumptions: 理想循环、集总工质；忽略不可逆细节时不得标工程机组效率

fieldlines.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 2（电场线约定）
fieldlines.assumptions: 静电、可视化约定；线密度不是定量工程场解

circuit.authority: Nilsson & Riedel, Electric Circuits, 一阶/二阶电路章节
circuit.assumptions: 集总参数、理想 R/L/C、基尔霍夫定律；非 SPICE 分布寄生与开关瞬态全模型

induction.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 7（法拉第定律）
induction.assumptions: 准静态、简单回路；非电机有限元

rays.authority: Hecht, Optics, 近轴几何光学 / 薄透镜方程
rays.assumptions: 近轴、薄透镜或单球面；虚像用虚线；非 Zemax 级像差设计

gauge.authority: 条目由主题求解器按名称积分标准关系；见模型 assumptions
gauge.assumptions: 方程与读数对应该条目公式，不再使用无关正弦占位

variant.authority: 族×维度变体：方程继承所属 family 的教科书形式，见 data/families.json
variant.assumptions: dims 只改系数/初值，不改变方程结构；超范围即失效

bohr.authority: Bransden & Joachain, Physics of Atoms and Molecules, 玻尔模型章节（历史模型）
bohr.assumptions: 玻尔轨道是历史近似，不是现代量子化学；禁止外推到分子合成

decay.authority: Krane, Introductory Nuclear Physics, 指数衰变定律章节
decay.assumptions: 常数衰变率、无链式工程燃耗；非反应堆燃料管理

discrete.authority: Cormen et al., Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS), 相关算法章节
discrete.assumptions: 离散步骤与不变量按该算法定义；可视化高亮不是复杂度证明本身

graph.assumptions: 有限图、非负权（Dijkstra）；点选连边须保持算法不变量

tree.assumptions: 有限树；步进高亮对应标准遍历/操作

fsm.authority: Hopcroft, Motwani, Ullman, Introduction to Automata Theory, 有限自动机
fsm.assumptions: 有限状态、确定或按模型声明的不确定转移；非工业 PLC 程序

turing.authority: Sipser, Introduction to the Theory of Computation, 图灵机章节
turing.assumptions: 纸带示意、有限步演示；非通用解释器

crypto.authority: Katz & Lindell, Introduction to Modern Cryptography, 对应原语章节（仅公开教学步骤）
crypto.assumptions: 教学步骤可视化；不提供攻击实现、密钥恢复或绕过

ml.authority: Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville, Deep Learning, 优化/损失章节（示意）
ml.assumptions: 低维损失面或单步更新示意；非训练框架、无生产数据

opt.authority: Nocedal & Wright, Numerical Optimization, 一阶方法章节
opt.assumptions: 低维目标示意；非工业求解器收敛保证

logic.authority: Mano, Digital Design, 组合逻辑门与真值表
logic.assumptions: 理想门、零延迟或按模型声明的单位延迟；非 VLSI 时序签核

arch.authority: Hennessy & Patterson, Computer Organization and Design, 流水线/缓存章节
arch.assumptions: 经典五级或 LRU 教学模型；非具体 CPU 微架构

embed.authority: Lee & Seshia, Introduction to Embedded Systems, 时序与采样示意
embed.assumptions: 逻辑时序示意；非目标板 BSP

comm.authority: Proakis & Salehi, Fundamentals of Communication Systems, 调制章节
comm.assumptions: 基带/理想信道示意；非链路预算软件

net.authority: Kurose & Ross, Computer Networking, 对应协议章节
net.assumptions: 协议步进示意；非数据包捕获或攻击

os.authority: Silberschatz, Operating System Concepts, 调度/同步章节
os.assumptions: 理想队列与时间片；非内核源码行为

compile.authority: Aho et al., Compilers (Dragon Book), 管线阶段概述
compile.assumptions: 阶段高亮示意；非完整编译器

dist.authority: Tanenbaum & van Steen, Distributed Systems, 共识章节（教学状态机）
dist.assumptions: 简化消息模型；非生产共识实现

struct.authority: Hibbeler, Structural Analysis / Mechanics of Materials, 梁内力与弯曲章节
struct.assumptions: 欧拉-伯努利、静定、小变形；非有限元、非塑性

control.authority: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering；Åström & Murray, Feedback Systems（PID/根轨迹）
control.assumptions: 线性时不变或标准 PID；非工业 DCS 整定软件、无执行器饱和全模型除非 schema 声明

chaos.authority: Strogatz, Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos, 对应标准方程（Lorenz 等）
chaos.assumptions: 常微分方程数值示意；参数即文献标准形，不外推为工程预报

traffic.authority: Nagel & Schreckenberg, J. Phys. I France 2, 2221 (1992)（NaSch 元胞自动机）
traffic.assumptions: 单车道元胞规则；非交通规划宏观模型

reactor.authority: Lamarsh & Baratta, Introduction to Nuclear Engineering, 点堆动力学章节（公开教科书）
reactor.assumptions: 点堆、单组缓发示意；非堆芯设计、非燃料循环、无增强路径

aero.authority: Anderson, Fundamentals of Aerodynamics；Etkin, Dynamics of Flight（线性化模态）
aero.assumptions: 小扰动或薄翼示意；非 CFD、非飞控适航模型

hand.authority: 手写精调：以该条目 authority 覆盖为准
hand.assumptions: 见条目 assumptions；未覆盖前不得标工程精度

free-fall.authority: Halliday, Resnick, Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, 直线运动；线性阻力见 Thornton & Marion §2.4
free-fall.assumptions: 竖直一维、常 g、线性阻力 F=−kv；不计浮力与二次阻力

projectile.authority: Halliday, Resnick, Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, 抛体运动
projectile.assumptions: 匀 g、无空气阻力（公式层）；平面运动；落地停止按模型选项

inclined-plane.authority: Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics, 斜面与库仑摩擦
inclined-plane.assumptions: 刚性斜面、库仑摩擦、质点；a=g(sinθ−μcosθ) 在下滑方向

spring.authority: Thornton & Marion, Classical Dynamics, §3.4–3.5（阻尼谐振子）
spring.assumptions: 胡克定律、粘滞阻尼、一维；忽略干摩擦与大变形

pendulum.authority: Thornton & Marion, Classical Dynamics, §4.2（单摆，含大角 sinθ）
pendulum.assumptions: 刚性轻杆、平面、集总质点；阻尼为粘滞项；非小角线性化除非参数进入小角区

collision.authority: Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics, 对心碰撞与恢复系数
collision.assumptions: 一维对心、碰撞瞬间外力冲量可忽略；e∈[0,1]

collision-2d.authority: Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics, 斜碰与冲量
collision-2d.assumptions: 刚体圆、接触法向冲量 + 恢复系数；摩擦按模型声明

double-pendulum.authority: Goldstein, Classical Mechanics, 拉格朗日方程应用于双摆
double-pendulum.assumptions: 平面、轻杆、集总质量；混沌对初值敏感，不作长期工程预报

wave.authority: Pain, The Physics of Vibrations and Waves, 一维波动方程
wave.assumptions: 均匀弦或介质、常波速、两端边界按实现；有限差分

heat.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 一维瞬态导热
heat.assumptions: 常物性、一维、无内热源（除非参数声明）；显式差分受稳定性限制

lorentz.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 5（洛伦兹力）
lorentz.assumptions: 点电荷、给定均匀场；忽略辐射阻尼

orbit.authority: Murray & Dermott, Solar System Dynamics, Ch. 2；或 Goldstein 有心势
orbit.assumptions: 二体、牛顿引力、点质量；非星历、非第三体

rc-circuit.authority: Nilsson & Riedel, Electric Circuits, 一阶 RC

rlc.authority: Nilsson & Riedel, Electric Circuits, 串联 RLC
rlc.assumptions: 集总串联、常系数；L I''+R I'+I/C=0

beam-sfd-bmd.authority: Hibbeler, Structural Analysis, 梁的剪力与弯矩（ΣV=0, ΣM=0）
beam-sfd-bmd.assumptions: 静定、欧拉-伯努利、小变形；非有限元

pid-tune.authority: Åström & Murray, Feedback Systems, Ch. 10；Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, PID
pid-tune.assumptions: 线性被控对象 + 理想 PID u=Kp e+Ki∫e+Kd ė；无工业执行器认证

hodgkin-huxley.assumptions: 空间钳位、枪乌贼巨轴突电导模型；仅公开生理方程，无增强或临床给药路径

sorting.authority: CLRS, 排序（插入/冒泡/快排）
sorting.assumptions: 比较排序的标准循环不变量；演示步不等于复杂度证明

bfs-grid.assumptions: 无权网格、四邻域或按实现；墙格不可通

dijkstra.assumptions: 边权非负；负权则算法不适用

logic-gates.authority: Mano, Digital Design, 基本门与真值表
logic-gates.assumptions: 理想布尔门；连线为网表示意

life.authority: Gardner / Berlekamp, Conway, Guy, Winning Ways（Life, B3/S23）
life.assumptions: 无限或环形网格按实现；元胞规则不是生物模型

pipeline.authority: Hennessy & Patterson, Computer Organization and Design, 经典五级流水线
pipeline.assumptions: 理想节拍、冒险按模型声明；非具体 ISA

cache-lru.authority: Hennessy & Patterson, Computer Organization and Design, 缓存与 LRU
cache-lru.assumptions: 全相联或按模型声明的组相联；理想命中时间

fifo.authority: Silberschatz, Operating System Concepts, 有界缓冲
fifo.assumptions: 互斥与空/满条件按经典问题；非真实内核

fam-heat-cond-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Fourier's law q=−κ ΔT/L (plane wall)
fam-heat-cond-v01.assumptions: Steady plane wall, constant thermal conductivity, no generation; ΔT = T(L) - T(0) and q = -κ ΔT/L.

fam-cond-eng-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Fourier's law for a single plane wall
fam-cond-eng-v01.assumptions: Single plane wall; thickness is thk; constant conductivity; steady; no generation; q = -κ ΔT/L.

fam-photoelectric-v01.authority: Einstein photoelectric equation (1905); Halliday (K_max independent of intensity; yield ∝ I above threshold)
fam-photoelectric-v01.assumptions: h*nu and W share one energy unit (h = 1 when the frequency knob is already an energy); no space charge; R is a relative yield and does not change K_max.

fam-collision-v01.authority: Thornton & Marion, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems, impact and the coefficient of restitution
fam-collision-v01.assumptions: 1D normal impact. Tangential velocity is unchanged. m1=mRatio, m2=1 kg, u1=1 m/s, u2=0.

fam-wave2d-v01.authority: Pain, The Physics of Vibrations and Waves, two-dimensional membrane
fam-wave2d-v01.assumptions: Linear membrane. Wave speed c=sqrt(T/rho). The readout is the (1,1) mode.

fam-kinetic-gas-v01.authority: Reif, Fundamentals of Statistical and Thermal Physics, Maxwell speed distribution
fam-kinetic-gas-v01.assumptions: Ideal gas. mMol is the molar mass in g/mol. v_rms=sqrt(3 R T / M).

fam-brownian-v01.assumptions: Ensemble mean-square displacement in one dimension, <x^2>=2 D t. Not a random path.

fam-entropy-mix-v01.authority: Cengel & Boles, Thermodynamics, entropy of mixing of ideal gases
fam-entropy-mix-v01.assumptions: Ideal binary mixture, one mole. Delta s/R = -sum x ln x. Temperature cancels in Delta s.

fam-compton-v01.authority: Compton, Phys. Rev. 21, 483 (1923); Eisberg & Resnick, Quantum Physics
fam-compton-v01.assumptions: Electron at rest. Photon energy E is in keV. Delta lambda is in pm. lambda_C=2.42631023867 pm.

fam-rel-dyn-v01.assumptions: c=1. Rest mass m=sqrt(E^2-p^2) when the interval is timelike; otherwise m=0.

fam-multiphase-v01.assumptions: Capillary length lambda_c=sqrt(sigma/(Delta rho * g)) with g=9.81 m/s^2.

fam-plasma-v01.authority: Chen, Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion, plasma frequency and cyclotron frequency
fam-plasma-v01.assumptions: Electron mass. Temperature is in eV. Classroom frequencies only; no device design.

fam-supercon-v01.authority: Tinkham, Introduction to Superconductivity, Ginzburg-Landau parameter

fam-magnetism-v01.authority: Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics, mean-field Curie temperature
fam-magnetism-v01.assumptions: k_B=1, coordination z=6, spin S=1/2. Anisotropy is reported separately and is not folded into T_C.

fam-topo-v01.authority: Thouless, Kohmoto, Nightingale and den Nijs, Phys. Rev. Lett. 49, 405 (1982)
fam-topo-v01.assumptions: Integer quantum Hall. sigma_xy/(e^2/h) equals the Chern number.

fam-well1d-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, infinite square well
fam-well1d-v01.assumptions: hbar=m=1. Ground state E_1=pi^2/(2 a^2). V0 is only a comparison with a finite well.

fam-tunnel-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, thick-barrier tunneling
fam-tunnel-v01.assumptions: hbar=m=1. T is approximately exp(-2 kappa w), kappa=sqrt(2(V0-E)). T=1 when E>=V0.

fam-qho-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, harmonic oscillator
fam-qho-v01.assumptions: hbar=1. Ground energy is omega/2. Coupling raises one normal frequency of two oscillators.

fam-wavepacket-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, free Gaussian wave packet
fam-wavepacket-v01.assumptions: hbar=m=1. Free Gaussian packet plus a constant potential.

fam-convection-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Newton's law of cooling and the laminar flat-plate correlation
fam-convection-v01.assumptions: Newton cooling per kelvin. The Blasius plate uses L=1 m and air properties nu=1.5e-5, Pr=0.7, k=0.026.

fam-conv-eng-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Newton's law of cooling
fam-conv-eng-v01.assumptions: Same Newton cooling and laminar flat-plate correlation as the classroom convection model.

fam-radiation-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Stefan-Boltzmann law
fam-radiation-v01.assumptions: Surface exitance q=epsilon sigma T^4. sigma=5.670374419e-8. No incoming irradiation.

fam-rad-eng-v01.authority: Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Stefan-Boltzmann exchange
fam-rad-eng-v01.assumptions: View factor 1 and a 0 K enclosure, so the net flux is the surface exitance epsilon sigma T^4.

fam-polarization-v01.assumptions: I=I0 cos^2(theta) with I0=1. The retarder phase does not change this intensity.

fam-maxwell-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 9, electromagnetic plane waves

fam-lorentz-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 5, the Lorentz force
fam-lorentz-v01.assumptions: Normalized charge and mass. The magnetic force magnitude is |q| v B for v perpendicular to B.

fam-magnetostat-v01.authority: Griffiths, Introduction to Electrodynamics, Ch. 5, Biot-Savart law at the center of a loop
fam-magnetostat-v01.assumptions: B=mu0 I/(2 R) at the center of a circular loop.

fam-antenna-v01.assumptions: Two-element array. Length and spacing are in wavelengths. This is not an electrostatics model.

fam-ising-v01.authority: Pathria and Beale, Statistical Mechanics, mean-field Ising model
fam-ising-v01.assumptions: Mean-field Ising with coordination number 4. Not the Onsager solution.

fam-percolation-v01.authority: Stauffer and Aharony, Introduction to Percolation Theory, one-dimensional site percolation
fam-percolation-v01.assumptions: Exact 1D site percolation. Mean finite-cluster size (1+p)/(1-p). Not a 2D Monte Carlo lattice.

fam-queueing-v01.authority: Gross, Shortle, Thompson and Harris, Fundamentals of Queueing Theory, M/M/1
fam-queueing-v01.assumptions: rho=lambda/mu. Mean system size L=rho/(1-rho) when rho<1. An unstable queue reports L=0 and stable=0.

fam-infotheory-v01.authority: Cover and Thomas, Elements of Information Theory, Shannon entropy
fam-infotheory-v01.assumptions: Binary entropy H=-p log2(p)-(1-p) log2(1-p), plus AWGN spectral efficiency at the stated SNR.

fam-combustion-v01.authority: Turns, An Introduction to Combustion, equivalence ratio
fam-combustion-v01.assumptions: Equivalence ratio only. The temperature knob is the reactant temperature, not a computed flame temperature.

fam-reactor-v01.authority: Fogler, Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering, isothermal first-order CSTR and PFR
fam-reactor-v01.assumptions: Isothermal irreversible first-order kinetics. Not a nuclear point-reactor model.

fam-distill-v01.authority: McCabe, Smith and Harriott, Unit Operations of Chemical Engineering, Fenske equation
fam-distill-v01.assumptions: Binary example with constant relative volatility alpha=2.5, xD=0.95, xB=0.05.

fam-absorb-v01.authority: McCabe, Smith and Harriott, Unit Operations of Chemical Engineering, absorption factor
fam-absorb-v01.assumptions: Single equilibrium stage with equilibrium slope m=1. Not a nuclear engineering model.

fam-extract-v01.authority: McCabe, Smith and Harriott, Unit Operations of Chemical Engineering, Kremser equation
fam-extract-v01.assumptions: Extraction factor S with distribution ratio 1. Not a nuclear engineering model.
